steps.content:
Algorithm Design and Text Programming

Term 1a Test

Year 9

  • First: 20 minutes of revision practice.
  • Then: a 30-minute test on this website.
  • Topics: number systems, loops, data types and arrays, errors and trace tables.
Think → Pair → ShareWhich topic do you find hardest?Show the answer

Practise that topic most in the next 20 minutes.

steps.label: Revision Practice
steps.content:
Revision Practice

Think → Pair → ShareA program has a bug. Do you follow what it should do, or what it says?Show the answer

What it says, one line at a time. Write every change in a trace table.

20 minutes. The questions are like the test, with different numbers. Choose a topic or practise them all.

steps.label: How the Test Works
steps.content:
How the Test Works

Think → Pair → ShareYour answers save as you type. Why does that help?Show the answer

If the computer crashes, you lose nothing. Open the site again and carry on.

  • You have 30 minutes from when you press Start.
  • Your answers save as you type.
  • During the test you cannot open the rest of the website.
  • The notepad works, but it starts empty. Your old notes come back after the test.
  • Press Hand in when you finish. When time runs out, it hands in for you.

steps.label: The Test
steps.content:
The Test

Think → Pair → ShareYou finish early. What should you do?Show the answer

Check every answer. Trace each program again, one line at a time.

Wait until your teacher says the test is open. Then press the button, and press Start.
